title: Sue and the Castle Bakery Door
synopsis: At Round Window Cottage, Sue adds a small flap door to her cardboard castle bakery and invents window orders for customers who cannot fit through it.
continuity_state: Before: Sue keeps her green yellow-star cushion and the existing cardboard castle bakery beside the round window. Grandpa Ed keeps the important spoon in his kitchen drawer. The Story House door no longer squeaks. After: With Grandpa Ed's help, Sue adds a small flap to the bakery door; it makes a soft fffup/flup sound. Sue and Amy draw a WINDOW ORDERS sign by the crayon window for pretend oversized customers. A paper beetle remains inside the bakery. The spoon goes back to the kitchen drawer, cushion remains Sue's, bakery remains by the round window.
